coverage.main: Read all ten pages of the CVPR 2021 open-access paper (pp. 9024-9033): Sections 1-5, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-4, Figures 1-4 and references. No arXiv version is listed in the corpus.
coverage.supplement: The CVF paper page lists only the PDF and BibTeX; no supplementary material was located (the conventional supplemental URL returned 404).
coverage.excluded_results: White-box (source-model) cells of Tables 1, 3 and 4; Figure 3 illustrates transformation-network outputs.

result_groups.population: 1,000 ILSVRC 2012 validation images of different categories, 'nearly all' of which the models classify correctly; Res-v2, Inc-v3, Inc-v4, IncRes-v2 sources; undefended and adversarially trained targets
result_groups.evidence: The authors 'ensure that nearly all of the selected test images can be correctly classified by every model', which describes the sample rather than stating a filter; clean-misclassified images may remain. No source-success rule is stated.

result_groups.population: Same images; Inc-v3 source; HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3 and other defended models
result_groups.evidence: No population rule for the defended targets.

f2.evidence: 'Nearly all' correctly classified is not an explicit restriction or an explicit inclusion statement; coded unclear rather than yes.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates; the rate denominator is not stated.

f5.evidence: Perturbation budget epsilon = 16 for all attacks (sign-gradient iterative L-infinity attacks).

f6.evidence: No code link in the paper and no author repository found by search.

artifact_checks.result: Paper page lists only the PDF and BibTeX; no supplement or code link.
One unrelated result (a 3D-attack repository); no author release located.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. The 'nearly all correctly classified' wording is recorded as partial positive evidence but not coded as a clean-correct restriction.
